page.overview:
Who is Connor Billings?

Connor O. Billings is a major character from Hide-and-Seek, the third story in Fazbear Frights 6: Blackbird. He's Toby's competitive and arrogant older brother who's always doing better than him.

Due to his job, Connor's button-up shirts, cheeks, and arms are usually covered in black grease. Black oil is also under his fingernails.

Connor is highly competitive, driven by a need to always be the best at everything seemingly as a result of his mother leaving at a young age. When things don’t go his way, he tends to get very aggressive and mopes around. Due to his usual success, Connor is rather loudmouthed and arrogant, constantly rubbing his fortune in Toby’s face. His confidence and conversational nature allowed him to excel at school, and his competitive nature made him rather outgoing and great at sports. Connor also shares his obsession with sports with his father, which the two bond over. While Connor does care for Toby, his need to be better makes him rather ignorant to his feelings.
